title: Legacy program staff take on dual roles to limit read-ins

tellings.quote: example this is something interesting I have have been told you might have a legacy program scientist who has to do a little bit of like accounting or personnel management stuff so they don't have to read in more people

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says he has been told how staff in a "legacy program", a long-running secret government effort said to study non-human craft, keep it small. According to what he was told, a scientist there might also do some accounting or personnel work so that fewer new people need to be "read in", formally cleared into the secret. If true, it would explain how such a program could stay hidden for decades.
